}}A woman who fought in the [[Last Battle]]. 

==Appearance==
She is slender.

==History==
She is from Tear.

== Activities ==
[[Mat]], giving a demonstration of how to shape stakes for the palisade they were constructing on the [[Field of Merrilor]], handed his axe to Cynd and told her to keep the stakes in line.

== Trivia ==
* Cynd is named for Cindy Goodman, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
